name: 1 Shanthiroad Studio Gallery
funding: Arts Council grants, philanthropic educational trusts, founder endowment; non-profit artist initiative.
watch: Founded by art historian Suresh Jayaram; Bangalore's open courtyard oasis for independent residencies and botanical research.

name: Britto Arts Trust
funding: Triangle Network, Prince Claus Fund, Arts Collaboratory, artist donations; registered non-profit trust.
watch: Bangladesh's first artist-run non-profit collective; organizers of the 54th Venice Biennale Bangladesh pavilion.

name: Sa Sa Art Projects
funding: Artist-run. Funding found: an online artist auction (2022), documenta fifteen money for a community studio, and a Rei Foundation partnership from 2018 to 2024. No funder list is published.
watch: Founded 2010 by the collective Stiev Selapak. Moved after the White Building was demolished in 2017.
records_note: Its site returned an authorization error, so reports, accounts, funders and board could not be checked; Rei Foundation and documenta fifteen are named elsewhere.

name: Theertha International Artists' Collective
funding: Arts Collaboratory, Prince Claus Fund, Triangle Network, artist self-management; registered non-profit trust.

name: Green Papaya Art Projects
watch: Oldest active artist-run non-profit initiative in Metro Manila (est. 2000).

name: Artspace Sydney
funding: Create NSW, Creative Australia (Australia Council), City of Sydney; registered non-profit visual arts organization.
watch: The historic Gunnery in Woolloomooloo; leading independent non-profit contemporary kunsthalle and 10 rent-free artist studios.

name: Artspace Aotearoa
funding: Creative New Zealand (NZ$637k a year for 2027 to 2029) and Auckland Council lead; strategic partners are Chartwell Trust, Foundation North, Goethe-Institut and Wesfarmers.
watch: Wesfarmers is mostly Bunnings and Kmart; its chemicals, energy and fertilisers division, which holds gas retailer Kleenheat, is about 5 percent of group revenue.
why_flagged: Wesfarmers is mostly Bunnings and Kmart; its chemicals, energy and fertilisers division, which holds gas retailer Kleenheat, is about 5 percent of group revenue.
records_note: It posted its audited 2025 annual report in September 2026, names partners and circle donors on its support page, and lists its Tiaki trustees.

name: Enjoy Contemporary Art Space
funding: Creative New Zealand, Wellington City Council; registered non-profit charitable trust.
watch: Wellington's longest-running independent artist-run space on Left Bank; free public exhibitions and critical writing.

name: Nafasi Art Space
funding: Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (SDC), Royal Norwegian Embassy, self-generated arts income; non-profit trust.
watch: TotalEnergies Tanzania partners on its VIA Creative programme.
why_flagged: TotalEnergies Tanzania partners on its VIA Creative programme.
records_note: It names its donors and supporters with funding years but posts no annual reports or accounts, and describes its board without naming anyone.

name: LE 18, Derb el Ferrane
funding: Artist-run space founded 2013; documenta fifteen lumbung member; funders not published.
records_note: Its About page names structural patron NOMAD (2015 to now) and partners for 2013 to 2023; no annual report, accounts or board.

name: Fondation H
funding: Fondation H philanthropic endowment; non-profit recognized public interest foundation, 100% free entry.
watch: Monumental non-profit contemporary art foundation housed in a renovated historic 1900 postal building; free universal access.
records_note: Shows 20 partner logos with no names or date; posts no annual reports or accounts, and names only its president and staff.

name: UKS (Unge Kunstneres Samfund / Young Artists' Society)
watch: Founded in 1921 by young artists; Norway's historic engine for experimental, political artist-run exhibitions and advocacy.
